question: Gadkari launches FASTag NHAI annual pass of ___________ for personal vehicles.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Rs 3,000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Gadkari launches FASTag NHAI annual pass of Rs 3,000 for personal vehicles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Nitin Gadkari** announced an **annual FASTag pass** for **private vehicles**.

 
 
• 
 
The pass will cost **₹3,000** and is valid for **1 year or 200 trips**, whichever comes first.

 
 
• 
 
It will be **effective from August 15**.

 
 
• 
 
Activation and renewal can be done via the **Rajmarg Yatra App** or the **NHAI website**.

 
 
• 
 
**FASTag** is mainly used for **toll payments**, but also supports **non-NHAI services** like **parking fees**.
